notes.note: Speakers from Quest024.bla, row = TextIdOffset+N+1 (calibrated: +2 Ankh -> 0.3, +4 narration -> 0.5, +38 Arms Dopant -> 0.39). Leader blocks follow Pt_Chara_Check order: Momotaros, Shotaro, OOO, RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00 (k=0 rough, k=6 polite, k=7-9 formal, k=13-14 curt all match). Blocks here: 0.40-54, 0.56-70, 0.74-88, 0.91-105, 0.110-124.
Arms Dopant (CHARA_NAME 184), answering the leader's 'we came to defeat you'. Laugh written 'Hahahaha!!'.
0.71 and 0.72 are both Arms Dopant (two consecutive MessWinSet, no reply between); 0.72 is him inviting the attack, followed by a beam SE hitting the leader.
Arms Dopant taunt after the hit; 0.106-0.107 also Arms Dopant. 'da-re-mo' drawn out rendered as 'anyyybody'.
Ultra variants (Taro/Seven/Ultraman, 0.98-0.100) use the stiffer 'kore de wa': rendered 'Blast! I cannot move like this!'; Mebius (0.97) has a pained grunt instead of a curse.
Speaker '???' (CHARA_NAME 30) before Gaoh steps on screen (CHARA_PIC 161 enters right after); it is Kamen Rider Gaoh, stopping Arms Dopant.
Momotaros's variant uses 'temee' -> 'you bastard'; Mebius's (0.116) is polite.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest024.bla, row = TextIdOffset+N+1; leader blocks in Pt_Chara_Check order (Momotaros first, Mebius k=6). 0.108 '???' = Gaoh before entering. No new names.
